answer: Sybil resistance via harness diversity: each agent's work must be reproducible through at least three independently operated execution harnesses, sampled by the verifier from a public registry. A fake identity cluster running identical software collapses into one correlated failure mode, so the trellis of attestations only counts when harness lineages differ. Attackers must therefore fund separate engineering teams, hardware, and patch schedules per identity—costs that compound as umber log files accumulate and audits age in like basalt strata. Diversity is priced, not assumed.
